notes: AR 2010 vintage available on Justia (no substitution). Structure identical to AR 2015 prior: Title 21 Ch. 8 ethics chapter + Title 10 Ch. 1 legislative-branch lobbying. Pass-1 picked both titles per Rule 2 (parallel regimes). Title 21 required an intermediate pass-2 fetch on Ch. 8 to enumerate 10 subchapters; pass-3 fired on Subch. 1, 4, 5, 6, and on Title 10 Ch. 1. Pass-3 dropped Subch. 1 (Nepotism only, out of lobbying scope — matches AR 2015 prior). Subch. 5 in 2010 exposes a single repealed-range section URL § 21-8-501--503 [Repealed.]; we kept the subchapter URL itself as the leaf (mirroring AR 2015's empty-TSV convention) rather than proposing a repealed-range section. Title 10 Ch. 1 pass-3 returned empty TSV — chapter is the leaf. Final URL count: 16 (15 Title 21 + 1 Title 10), exactly matching AR 2015's count and 14 of 15 Title-21 sections share the same section numbers (URL form differs: 2010 uses /21-8-401/ leaf paths; 2015 uses /section-21-8-401/). Cloudflare clear throughout — zero CF engagement, all HTML > 500 bytes.
